subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 1 – Lesson 8: Literacy – Reading an interview
outcomes: I can scan an interview to find information.
I can say if a sentence is true, false or doesn't say.
I can guess new words like route and hostel from the text.

tf.s: Henry and Cody are visiting Argentina and Chile.
tf.why: Yes! They cycle in Argentina and Chile.

tf.s: There is a lot of oxygen high in the Andes.
tf.why: Above 4,000 metres there isn't much oxygen.

tf.s: Henry and Cody are sleeping in a hostel tonight.
tf.why: Correct! Tonight they sleep in a hostel.

tf.s: When there aren't any hostels, they sleep in a hotel.
tf.why: If there aren't any hostels, they camp in a tent.

tf.s: Henry and Cody are always hungry because cycling uses a lot of energy.
tf.why: Right! Cycling uses lots of energy.

tf.s: The interview says that Cody is a teacher.
tf.why: The interview doesn't say what Cody's job is.

tf.s: A hostel is a very cheap and simple hotel.
"Route" means the way you go to a place.
tf.why: Great! A route is your way.
Altitude means how high a place is above sea level.

tf.s: On a cycling trip in Oman, you need lots of water because it's hot.
tf.why: Yes, water is very important in the heat.

boxes.q: Which countries are Henry and Cody visiting?
boxes.why: They cycle in Argentina and Chile.
Tonight they sleep in a hostel.
They send blog posts and emails.

boxes.q: A very cheap and simple hotel is a ___.
The way you go to a place is a ___.
How high a place is above sea level =
The mountains they cycle over are the ___.

o: Cycling uses a lot of energy.

boxes.q: Henry and Cody are travelling on two ___.
boxes.why: The interview is called Adventures on two wheels.

boxes.q: A person who loves cycling is a keen ___.
boxes.why: Keen cyclist means someone who loves cycling.

o: how high a place is above sea level
a very cheap and simple hotel
mcq.why: A hostel is a cheap, simple hotel.

mcq.q: What do Henry and Cody do if there aren't any hostels?

o: questions and answers with a person
mcq.why: An interview has questions and answers.

mcq.q: "Henry and Cody are always hungry." True, false or doesn't say?
o: True, because cycling uses a lot of energy.
False, because they are in a hostel.
mcq.why: The interview tells us they are always hungry.

mcq.q: You want to find which question mentions camping. What do you do?
o: Scan the questions quickly for the word.
mcq.why: Scanning helps you find information fast.

mcq.q: Which sentence plans a cycling route in Oman?
o: We're going to start in Muscat and cycle to Sur.
We're going to ski in Muscat.
We're going to cycle to Chile.
mcq.why: Muscat to Sur is a route in Oman.

mcq.q: Why is cycling over the Andes difficult?
o: It's above 4,000 metres and there isn't much oxygen.

mcq.q: "Cody is a teacher." Why is the answer "doesn't say"?
o: The interview gives no information about Cody's job.
The interview says Cody is a doctor.
The interview says Cody is a teacher.
mcq.why: If the text doesn't tell us, the answer is "doesn't say".
